title: Flowchart / process diagram
description: A process expressed as steps connected by arrows. Each node is an activity or decision; each edge is a sequencing (ordering) relationship whose label may carry a branch condition.

mapping.notes: an activity/step becomes a WORK concept
a decision gateway becomes a WORK concept; branch conditions live on outgoing edges
an arrow becomes an ORDERING relationship; capture every arrow, that is where sequencing and conditions live

guidance: Segment every node AND every edge - arrows carry the sequencing and are the easiest to drop.
Model nodes as identity-bearing WORK concepts and edges as identity-bearing ORDERING relationships so each is independently traceable.
Swimlanes assign an actor to the steps in the lane; capture the actor and its participation.
